content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, dated 30 October 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Scientist-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF pages 3 to 5) and send it to Principal Investigator, Dental Technology Innovation Hub, Room No. 309, 3rd Floor, Phase II Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, MAMC Campus, BS Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002, by by hand or by post, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of closure of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B. Tech in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The posts are purely on contract basis and subject to the end date of the project. Incumbent will also have no right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of documents as per eligibility criteria. Interview of shortlisted candidates. The candidates will be shortlisted after scrutiny of documents as per eligibility criteria. The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration of contract is for a period of 6 months or the end date of the project, whichever is earlier. May be extended based on performance and extension granted by DST.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.
